dedupe_keys.name: u s climate resilience toolkit tools and case studies

description: U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit (tools and case studies) is a national toolkit listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Climate Program Office and partners (NEMAC). It is a federal website that lists over 500 climate-adaptation tools and about 300 case studies of communities, utilities and agencies adapting to drought, heat, flooding, coastal hazards and wildfire, filterable by hazard, asset, region and the five steps of its resilience process. Coverage: the United States, with some tools of wider reach. Each tool and case study has its own page with hazards, assets and sources. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit pages read. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding climate-adaptation tools and precedents for infrastructure planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
licence: not stated on the toolkit pages read
